stdout:
Mark comments as spam. Use this tool to mark comments as spam.

Usage:
  yutu comment markAsSpam [flags]

Examples:
# Mark a comment as spam
yutu comment markAsSpam --ids abc123
# Mark multiple comments as spam
yutu comment markAsSpam --ids abc123,def456

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for markAsSpam
  -i, --ids strings     IDs of comments
  -o, --output string   json|yaml|silent
      --yes             Confirm the operation
